'''2020 TMW Pods Ryan Sersen DS Dagobah: Cave''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Sersen]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Sersen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Cave|Dagobah-D-dagobahcave.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Slip Sliding Away (V)|V12-D-slipslidingaway.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Dagobah Cave Sersen DS 2020 Texas.txt |Download]]
